items.question: Is ProjectEVE free?
items.answer: Yes! We have a free plan with up to 5 envelopes and 1 income source. For advanced features, we offer paid plans starting at $9/month.

items.question: Is my financial data safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption and your data is never shared with third parties. You have full control over your information.

items.question: What is the envelope method?
items.answer: The envelope method is a budgeting technique where you divide your income into 'envelopes' (categories) before spending. It helps you control expenses and avoid debt.

items.question: Can I use it on multiple devices?
items.answer: Yes! ProjectEVE is a web app that works on any device with a browser: computer, tablet, or phone.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, no questions or cancellation fees. You can cancel your subscription at any time from the settings panel.

items.question: Does it work offline?
items.answer: ProjectEVE currently requires an internet connection. We are working on an offline mode for future versions.

items.question: Is there a mobile app?
items.answer: For now, ProjectEVE is a responsive web app that works well on mobile. A native app is on our roadmap.

items.question: How do I migrate from another tool?
items.answer: You can import your data via CSV spreadsheet. Our support team can help with the migration process.
